name: learn-kit
description: Pedagogical kit for learnable knowledge artifacts. Includes (1) 8-stage manual authoring methodology + scaffold + discovery skills (init / locate / scan); (2) AI-driven three-tier (foundation/structural/challenge) learning doc generator with optional interactive HTML rendering; (3) nlm-studio skill that pushes a topic's three-tier corpus to NotebookLM and generates up to 15 online-viewable multimedia artifacts (audio + video + slide_deck + mind_map + infographic, each in 3 view variants) while preserving each view's pedagogical purpose. Requires notebooklm-mcp MCP server (bundled via this plugin's .mcp.json) plus a one-time `nlm login` for the nlm-studio skill; the other four skills run with no external dependencies.
